asset.name: The Moonlit Vow
asset.description: Find the forgotten relic in the Moonlit Glade and make the stele remember its warden.

nodes.title: Moonlit Glade
nodes.text: Moonlight falls on the stele, but its face is blank.

nodes.title: A Name Returns
nodes.text: As the dagger leaves its sheath, a forgotten name rises on the stone.
